# Vendored libraries

Unmodified `dist/` files from npm. Loaded as classic `<script>` tags; each defines a global.
To update: `npm pack <pkg>@<ver>`, copy the file below, and re-run the Picture QR checks.

| Library | Version | File | Global | License | sha256 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [qrcode-generator](https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator) | 2.0.4 | `qrcode-generator/qrcode.js` (`dist/qrcode.js`) | `qrcode` | MIT — `qrcode-generator/LICENSE` | `79ec86f82856005b1c887905cfccfcfbec3821ca61c7fd5a952faa5f778f791c` |
| [jsQR](https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR) | 1.4.0 | `jsqr/jsQR.js` (`dist/jsQR.js`) | `jsQR` | Apache-2.0 — `jsqr/LICENSE` | `bc40c8a15196236b2314db0856f72ca0b49980cd5413b8c852a7349f5fee0859` |

The qrcode-generator npm package ships no LICENSE file; `qrcode-generator/LICENSE` is the MIT text with the copyright line from the header of `qrcode.js`.
